variant_group_meaning: Requirements associated with the same candidate reference by source paths and explicit filename aliases. Grouping records possible source variants; it does not establish semantic equivalence or human-verified ground truth.
mapping_notes: stepper-motor_output contains WBS/arp4761 requirement variants; it does not map to the stepper-motor reference project.
Original source directories and filename case are preserved in both copied trees.
All path/reference/reference_project fields are relative to example. Family groups consolidate source variants and do not establish independent examples or gold labels.

license_notices.references: Existing per-file copyright, permission and warranty notices are preserved verbatim. No new license is granted by this manifest.
license_notices.requirements: Legacy text provenance and licensing remain unverified; new public text retains the source repository LICENSE/Notice and source identifiers. No rights are inferred from an AADL model.

requirements.evaluation_scope: Static syntax and semantics only; functional behavior is not established by this dataset.
requirements.extraction: Verbatim README section excerpts and complete Mission Key Management and Logging Component StrictDoc sections; IDs, statement and rationale retained.
requirements.coverage_notes: Selected original requirements cover MKM and logging behavior and authored system context, but do not uniquely determine every declaration in the core AADL architecture.

requirements.evaluation_scope: Static syntax and semantics only; functional behavior is not established by this dataset.
requirements.extraction: Complete original document MIS_SSS from MIS-SSS.reqdoc: all 284 SYS_* requirements, original declaration context, quoted descriptions and any rationale/issues retained. Source path is stated once; each record retains its ID and original source line. The other nine original documents remain reference artifacts and are not merged into this input.
requirements.coverage_notes: The original document contains broader MIS system and behavioral requirements. Complete coverage of all imported architecture declarations has not been established. No architecture details are inferred from the reference model. Intentional source interface errors and EMV2 annexes are retained.
